items.title: Outcrop Silver Reports High-Grade Drill Results from Aguilar and Morena Targets
items.summary: Assay results from exploration drilling at Aguilar and Morena targets continue to expand high-grade silver mineralized shoots within the flagship Santa Ana project.

items.title: Outcrop Silver Presents at the Precious Metals & Critical Minerals Virtual Investor Conference
items.summary: Outcrop Silver & Gold Corporation presented an update on the progress of its high-grade primary silver project, Santa Ana, highlighting resource definitions and optimization paths.

items.title: Outcrop Expands Aguilar Vein System with New High-Grade Silver Intercepts
items.summary: Drilling results show continued expansion of high-grade mineralization along the Aguilar vein system, reinforcing growth potential in our flagship asset.

items.title: Outcrop Silver Engages Investor Relations Consultant
items.summary: The Company is expanding its inbound and outbound investor relations through an experienced IR consultant.

items.title: Outcrop Silver Appoints Carlos Torres as VP Exploration to Advance Resource Growth
items.summary: An experienced exploration geologist with mining experience joins the leadership team to accelerate resource growth and development at the Santa Ana project.

items.title: Outcrop Reports Additional High-Grade Drill Results from Guadual Target
items.summary: Drilling at the Guadual target continues to yield excellent results, demonstrating solid thickness and high-grade silver mineralization in newly tested shoots.

items.title: Outcrop Silver Announces Management Transition: Appoints Rob Bruggeman as CEO
items.summary: The Corporation announces the transition of its executive team, appointing Rob Bruggeman as President, CEO, and Director, bringing over 20 years of mining finance experience.

items.title: Outcrop Reports Resource Definition Drilling Results at Aguilar Vein
items.summary: Assay results from resource definition drilling at the Aguilar vein target continue to define thick, high-grade shoots, supporting mineral resource update calculations.

items.title: Outcrop Silver Announces Results of Annual General and Special Meeting
items.summary: All resolutions proposed at the Annual General and Special Meeting of Shareholders (AGM) were successfully passed, including the reelection of the board of directors.

items.title: Outcrop Silver Publishes Annual Letter to Shareholders
items.summary: President and CEO reviews the milestone achievements of 2025, detailing exploration expansions, drilling program advancements, and graduation to the TSX main board.

items.title: Outcrop Extends Aguilar Vein 450 Metres South
items.summary: Step-out drilling along the Aguilar vein system has successfully extended the mapped mineralization structure by 450 metres to the south.

items.title: Outcrop Silver Completes Graduation to TSX Main Board
items.summary: Outcrop Silver is pleased to announce it has completed all requirements for listing on the Toronto Stock Exchange, with trading to commence on the main board.
